historyBefore.text: I want to learn Facebook ads

Great! To help you learn Facebook ads, could you please clarify if you want to:

1. Learn how to run and manage Facebook ads yourself with guidance and setup support, or
2. Have Joshspot Media run and manage the Facebook ad campaigns for you?

This will help me recommend the right service or course for you.

Thanks for letting me know you want to learn ads for both Facebook (Meta) and TikTok.

To assist you best, do you want help with just the account setup and learning to run ads yourself on both platforms, or would you prefer Joshspot Media to run and manage the ad campaigns for you on Facebook and TikTok? You can also choose both services if you want setup plus management.

Let me know your preference so I can guide you accordingly.

Facebook (Meta) and TikTok advertising learning are typically covered in separate courses or services because the platforms have different interfaces, tools, and strategies. However, some training programs may bundle both platforms for comprehensive learning.

Would you like me to share details about available courses or services for Facebook and TikTok ads separately or as a combined option if available? Also, are you aiming for self-learning with setup guidance or full management where Joshspot runs your campaigns?
how much and where can I get it

We offer both Facebook (Meta) and TikTok ads setup and management services, but the pricing depends on your budget and duration preferences.

Could you please tell me: 
- Your intended budget (daily or total ad spend), and 
- How long you want to run the learning or management service?

This info will help me provide accurate pricing and where you can access the course or management service. Also, please confirm if you want just setup guidance (so you learn and run ads yourself) or full campaign management by Joshspot Media.

content.text:
Thanks for your interest! 

We offer courses and services for both Facebook (Meta) and TikTok ads, including setup guidance for self-learning and full campaign management by Joshspot Media. Pricing depends on your budget, service choice, and campaign duration.

To provide accurate options and costs, could you share:  
- Your intended budget (daily or total ad spend)?  
- How long you plan to run the ads or service?  
- Whether you want just setup guidance (to learn and run ads yourself) or full management handled by us?

This will help me guide you to the right course or service and let you know where to access it.
